title: 26 U.S. Code 7872, Treatment of loans with below-market interest rates
issuer: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School (U.S. Code text)

passages.question: Is the $120,000.00 advance to Juniper Ridge Partners LLC a loan, and does it carry imputed interest?
passages.excerpt: (a) Treatment of gift loans and demand loans (1) In general. For purposes of this title, in the case of any below-market loan to which this section applies and which is a gift loan or a demand loan, the forgone interest shall be treated as ... (C) Corporation-shareholder loans. Any below-market loan directly or indirectly between a corporation and any shareholder of such corporation.
